cmd:
set -euo pipefail
cd /ssd6/hungwei/icpe-next/main-ana
export RUN_ID=20261106-084846-icpe-main-verA-ttl3 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
PY="nice -n 19 /ssd6/hungwei/icpe-next/venv/bin/python -I"
O=/ssd6/hungwei/icpe-next/runs/20261106-084846-icpe-main-verA-ttl3/out
B=results/icpe_next/b
AN=code/icpe/next_sim_analyze.py
TTL4="TTLA:1 TTLA:3 TTLA:30 TTLA:100 TTLB:1 TTLB:3 TTLB:30 TTLB:100"
# 版本 A：3 個 TTL（偏離 4）；CacheWise 另算偏離 5（cw_main＋cw_main_ttl7，--rival-only-gpu）
$PY $AN --sweep $B/cw_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out-dir $O --out-prefix cw_ttl3 --pf-target cpu
$PY $AN --sweep $B/cw_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/cw_main_ttl7/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out-dir $O --out-prefix cw_dev5 --pf-target cpu --rival-only-gpu $TTL4
$PY $AN --sweep $B/tl_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out-dir $O --out-prefix tl_ttl3 --pf-target cpu
$PY $AN --sweep $B/sa_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out-dir $O --out-prefix sa_ttl3 --pf-target cpu
$PY $AN --sweep $B/bl_main/bailian3/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out-dir $O --out-prefix bl_ttl3 --pf-target cpu
$PY $AN --sweep $B/old_main/mooncake/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out-dir $O --out-prefix mc_ttl3 --pf-target cpu
$PY $AN --sweep $B/old_main/fi6w/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out-dir $O --out-prefix fi_ttl3 --pf-target cpu
# 對拍：和現有的表逐格相同（去掉 run_id、ts、host）
$PY code/icpe/main_cmp.py --name cw_ttl3_headroom --a $O/cw_ttl3_headroom_components.csv --b $B/analysis/cw_main_ttl3/cw_main_ttl3_headroom_components.csv.xz --out $O/cmp.csv
$PY code/icpe/main_cmp.py --name cw_ttl3_violations --a $O/cw_ttl3_violations.csv --b $B/analysis/cw_main_ttl3/cw_main_ttl3_violations.csv --out $O/cmp.csv
$PY code/icpe/main_cmp.py --name cw_dev5_headroom --a $O/cw_dev5_headroom_components.csv --b $B/analysis/cw_main_final/cw_main_final_headroom_components.csv.xz --out $O/cmp.csv
$PY code/icpe/main_cmp.py --name cw_dev5_violations --a $O/cw_dev5_violations.csv --b $B/analysis/cw_main_final/cw_main_final_violations.csv.xz --out $O/cmp.csv
$PY code/icpe/main_cmp.py --name sa_ttl3_headroom --a $O/sa_ttl3_headroom_components.csv --b $B/analysis/sa_main_ttl3/sa_main_ttl3_headroom_components.csv.xz --out $O/cmp.csv
$PY code/icpe/main_cmp.py --name sa_ttl3_violations --a $O/sa_ttl3_violations.csv --b $B/analysis/sa_main_ttl3/sa_main_ttl3_violations.csv.xz --out $O/cmp.csv
# 彙總與判定：A_report＝偏離 6 的解讀（CacheWise 用偏離 5 版，其他 3 個 TTL 未補跑）；A_ttl3＝全部 3 個 TTL（同一組規則）
SW="$B/cw_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/tl_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/sa_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/bl_main/bailian3/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/old_main/mooncake/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/old_main/fi6w/x1_sweep.csv.xz"
REST="TraceLab=$O/tl_ttl3_headroom_components.csv SemiAnalysis=$O/sa_ttl3_headroom_components.csv Bailian=$O/bl_ttl3_headroom_components.csv Mooncake=$O/mc_ttl3_headroom_components.csv FreeInference=$O/fi_ttl3_headroom_components.csv"
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --version "A_report: CacheWise=dev5 (ttl7 rival-only on >=10% cells); others=3 TTL, no >=10% rerun (dev4)" --headroom CacheWise=$O/cw_dev5_headroom_components.csv $REST --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verA_report
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --version "A_ttl3: all families 3 TTL (dev4, before any rerun)" --headroom CacheWise=$O/cw_ttl3_headroom_components.csv $REST --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verA_ttl3
# p90（PREREG §1：只報告）
for f in cw tl sa bl mc fi; do
  case $f in cw) S="$B/cw_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz";; tl) S="$B/tl_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz";; sa) S="$B/sa_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz";;
    bl) S="$B/bl_main/bailian3/x1_sweep.csv.xz";; mc) S="$B/old_main/mooncake/x1_sweep.csv.xz";; fi) S="$B/old_main/fi6w/x1_sweep.csv.xz";; esac
  $PY $AN --sweep $S --out-dir $O --out-prefix ${f}_ttl3_p90 --pf-target cpu --metric p90_ret
done
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --report-only --version "A_ttl3_p90 (report only)" --headroom CacheWise=$O/cw_ttl3_p90_headroom_components.csv TraceLab=$O/tl_ttl3_p90_headroom_components.csv SemiAnalysis=$O/sa_ttl3_p90_headroom_components.csv Bailian=$O/bl_ttl3_p90_headroom_components.csv Mooncake=$O/mc_ttl3_p90_headroom_components.csv FreeInference=$O/fi_ttl3_p90_headroom_components.csv --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verA_ttl3_p90
